policies.unavailable_reason: No fully qualified hardware checkpoint selected across 8 validation suites; no final-weight fallback.
Macro not trained: no qualified frozen seed-1000 hardware checkpoint.

blocking_campaign_job.reason: No fully qualified hardware validation checkpoint

policies.unavailable_reason: No fully qualified macro checkpoint selected across 6 validation suites; no final-weight fallback.

not_attempted_surfaces.reason: The pilot registers hardware-only continuations. No macro was trained against these final hardware hashes. Original learned macros must not be transplanted onto restored weights.
Strict validation-only inventory; no held-out evaluation or selection.

baseline.source_identity_scopes: source_id hashes Python files; snapshot source_id also hashes configuration YAML. These different IDs are intentional.

inference_caveats: Original candidates are the best qualified checkpoints selected across training; restored candidates are all registered critic_restore final-budget checkpoints. This is a candidate inventory, not evidence of algorithmic superiority.
The twelve restored candidates are three continuation streams nested within each of four selected parent seeds, not twelve independent from-scratch training seeds.

Re-evaluations of the four original validation cells are not independent new samples. The four bias counterparts reuse the same day's two seeds; matched comparisons remain dependent within day, seed, parent, and continuation stream.
Prior qualification is based on the four original cells, not a claim of qualification on the eight-cell matched validation matrix.
parent_selected_low_id on restored policies identifies a same-seed comparison candidate, not the continuation's actual late-step initial weights.
Macro and hardware selection_score values are mean reward per their respective decision step and must not be compared directly across control levels.

verification.consumer_instruction: Consume this inventory without reselecting models. Proceed only if verification.status is passed. Preserve unavailable policy cells and include available diagnostic-only final checkpoints.

primary_contrasts: Every available policy versus rule macro + nominal fixed hardware
Learned macro versus rule macro with the exact same hardware checkpoint
Restored final hardware versus its parent's selected healthy hardware, when available
Each policy beta=.5 versus its own beta=0 on the same day and seed
economic_definition: Delta benchmark settlement revenue minus delta metered grid-import cost; before recovery, degradation valuation and workload-service valuation. Terminal battery, queue and thermal obligations reported separately.
gate_policy: Prior checkpoint eligibility, runtime completeness, and current cell qualification are separate axes
missingness_policy: Unavailable policies and failed/terminated cells remain explicit; no prefix or survivor-only score
scope: Selected-checkpoint validation inventory, not an independent algorithm ranking or held-out paper result
settlement_scope: Benchmark price/quantity/performance settlement proxy; not a claim about actual ISO payments or system-wide avoided costs
